# Proppr.io - LLM Documentation Index
# https://llmstxt.org standard

> Proppr is a football betting intelligence ecosystem with 3 Telegram bots powered by the "Cerebro" statistical model.

## Documentation Files

- [Full Documentation](https://docs.proppr.io/llms-full.txt) - Complete 174KB reference
- [Condensed Context](https://docs.proppr.io/llms-context.txt) - 2KB quick reference
- [Player Bot Guide](https://docs.proppr.io/llms-player.txt) - 56KB player props documentation
- [Team Bot Guide](https://docs.proppr.io/llms-team.txt) - 40KB team markets documentation
- [Arb Bot Guide](https://docs.proppr.io/llms-arb.txt) - 80KB arbitrage documentation

## Quick Reference

### The Three Bots
1. **Player Bot** (@PropprPlayerBot) - Value betting on player props (shots, cards, goals, tackles)
2. **Team Bot** (@PropprTeamBot) - Team market analysis (corners, cards, possession)
3. **Arb Bot** (@PropprArbBot) - Real-time arbitrage detection across 150+ bookmakers

### Core Formula
Value % = ((Bookmaker Odds / Model Odds) - 1) × 100

### Key Philosophy
> "The bot is NOT a tipster - use it as a tool to point you in the right direction."

### Pricing Tiers
- Reserve: Free (basic alerts)
- Bench Player: £7.99/month
- Regular Starter: £19.99/month
- Club Legend: £29.99/month
